scope: ELF/DWARF file-scope globals and statics with exact DW_OP_addr and matching allocated symtab object; constant structure-member offsets; RAM scalars only
identity: Complete internal flash PT_LOAD LMA contents must match in this connection before watch RAM reads; no authentication or atomic flash identity proof
consistency: non_atomic_live_read; host read time is not MCU sample time; no implicit MCU age or readiness inferred
control: No target writes, halt, reset, resume, call, breakpoint or configuration commands. Existing explicitly documented core-identity observations remain separate from RAM watch.
